```{r}

## Load packages
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

```



### Visualization 1



```{r}

drives <- read.csv("https://remiller1450.github.io/data/drives.csv") ## Load data set
   

drives_NA <- na.omit(drives) %>% ## Remove observations with missing values
  group_by(Subject, Drive) %>% 
  mutate(Total_Departures = LaneDeparts_Left +
           LaneDeparts_Right) %>% ## Add column combining left and right departures
  summarize(total = sum(Total_Departures))

```



```{r}

ggplot(drives_NA, aes(x = total, color = Drive, 
                      fill = Drive)) + ## Create the histogram
  geom_histogram(bins = 10, alpha = .5, 
                 position = "identity") +   
  facet_wrap(~ Drive) + ## Divide into four sub graphs to show each four drives 
  labs(
       x = "Total Number of Departures",
       y = "Frequency") + ## Label graph
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("RT1" = "red", "RT2" = "lightgreen", 
                               "RT3" = "cyan", "RT4" = "orange")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("RT1" = "red", "RT2" = "lightgreen", 
                                "RT3" = "cyan", "RT4" = "orange")) +
  theme_minimal()

```



### Visualization 2



```{r}

target <- read.csv("https://collinn.github.io/teaching/2023/data/target.csv")
cohort <- read.csv("https://collinn.github.io/teaching/2023/data/cohort.csv") 
## Load data set

target_join <- left_join(x = target, y = cohort, by = c("subjectID", "time")) ## Merge 
## data sets "target" and "cohort"
target_longer<- pivot_longer(target_join, 
             cols = !subjectID & !time, 
             names_to = "Target", 
             values_to = "Proportion") ## Rearrange data to combine 
## experimental conditions and generate a column 
## for the proportion of looks the subject looked at 
## "Target" and "Cohort" images
target_separate <- separate(target_longer, 
                       col = Target, 
                       into = c("Noise", "Method"),
                       sep = "[.]") ## Separate column into experimental condition 
## and type of image

```



```{r}

ggplot(target_separate, aes(x = time, y = Proportion)) + ## Create line graph
  geom_line(aes(color = factor(subjectID))) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "black") +
  facet_grid(Noise ~ Method) + ## Two categorical variables are present 
## therefore this function is required to display 
## 6 sub graphs
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Proportion") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") 

```
